You will be responsible for the safe movement of goods within the warehouse. As an forklift driver, you'll ensure that everything is placed in the correct location. You make sure the logistics process always runs smoothly.

 what we offer

 who you are 
As a forklift driver for FedEx Duiven, you recognize yourself in the following points: - You are at least 18 years old (due to working with machinery) - You are available to work at least 24 hours per week - You are available to work at least 3 days per week - You have a valid forklift certificate - You speak Dutch or English - You are able to work in Duiven 
 what will you do 
As an forklift driver at FedEx in Duiven, you will work daily with pallets and goods. You are responsible for the safe movement of freight within the warehouse. First, you'll scan the pallets with incoming goods. Then, you'll take them to the scale to be weighed. Afterward, you will place the weighed pallets in the correct spot, ready for shipping. This ensures the warehouse remains organized. 
It's important to note that you won't be solely driving the forklift. You will also contribute to order picking and helping out in the warehouse...

Would you like to work in a high-tech environment with plenty of opportunities to grow? Apply now for this exciting Assembly Worker position!

Are you technically inclined, do you enjoy working with metal, and do you know what to do with a MIG/MAG welding machine? Then we have a great full-time job for you! 
For an international manufacturing company, we are looking for a MIG/MAG Welder / Metalworker. You will be working on the production of metal stable systems and components for the livestock industry. This is a practical role where you work independently but are also part of a team. As a MIG/MAG Welder / Bench Worker, you will be involved in various metalworking activities. Your work includes: - Welding metal parts using the MIG/MAG method - The processing and working of various metals and materials - Reading technical drawings and work orders - Operating machines and various hand tools - Checking the quality and neat finish of your work - Supporting colleagues with various tasks within production What do we expect from you? - You have a technical education, preferably in metalworking or mechanical engineering. - You have experience with MIG/MAG welding. - You possess a welding certificate - You are skilled with hand tools and machines - You work accurately and have an eye for quality. - You are open to working with various materials and techniques. - You can manage well in English or Dutch. - You are looking for a long-term job. About the company 
You will be working at an international manufacturing company that develops and produces high-quality stable systems for sheep and goats. This includes fencing, feed barriers, farrowing pens, and various metal accessorie...

What will you do?

As a TIG Welder, you will work closely with a small and experienced team to build high-quality stainless steel filter systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- TIG welding of stainless steel components (RVS/INOX)
- Assembling parts based on technical drawings
- Welding both precision components and larger constructions
- Checking dimensions and product quality
- Contributing ideas for technical improvements and solutions
- Helping build complete filtration systems from start to finish

- Experience as a TIG Welder
- Experience with stainless steel (preferred)
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good communication skills in English, German, or Dutch
- Eye for detail and quality
- Motivated and reliable attitude

As a warehouse employee at DHL, you help sort parcels and make sure each parcel ends up in the right place. Thanks to your work, parcels are sorted on time and delivered to customers.

You can start by placing parcels onto the conveyor belt so they can be sorted, or by taking sorted parcels off the belt and placing them in a roll cage. Later, DHL gives you the opportunity to learn and carry out other tasks in the warehouse.

Please note: parcels can weigh up to 25 kg. Most parcels are lighter, but heavier parcels sometimes occur. You always lift these together with a colleague.

Working Hours

- Day shift: 08:00–16:00
- Evening shift: 16:00–00:00
- Intermediate shift: 18:00–02:00
- Night shift: 00:00–08:00

You can work across a maximum of two different shifts.

- You are available at least 3 to 4 days per week.
- You can lift parcels weighing up to 25 kg, with a colleague’s help for heavier parcels.

At the start of your shift, you check the production line with your team. Once everything is ready, the production process begins. You help keep the line running and make sure products are processed correctly. Together with your colleagues, you make sure everything runs smoothly.

Your tasks include:

- Working on a production line with about 5 colleagues
- Cutting, filling, packing and labeling food products
- Keeping the workplace clean and organized

You play an important role in the production process.
